info.description:
Document intelligence and evidence reconciliation for UK mortgage brokers.

**Phase 1** covers firms, members, mortgage cases, applicants and the audit trail.

All `/api/v1` endpoints except `/me` require an `X-Tenant-ID` header naming the firm the
request acts within. Money is always integer minor units (pence) with an explicit currency.
Figures marked *declared* are borrower statements and are **not verified**.

Response List Approvals Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Profile Approvals Get

post.description: Attests the profile exactly as loaded: send its `fingerprint` and the current `attestation_version` with `confirmed: true`. In one transaction under the case lock, the profile is rebuilt; any blocker, or a different fingerprint, refuses. Otherwise the approval is stored (the canonical snapshot text, its hash, and the exact attestation wording) as the next version, and the case becomes `verified`. Approving is the only way to verify a case. Approving the profile accepts the reviewed figures as supported enough to assess; it does not approve a mortgage. Guided journey: if the case has its loan details, the mortgage assessment starts in the same transaction and runs in the background (`X-Assessment-Id`). Needs `profile:approve` (firm admin, adviser).
